name: Chat browser
description:
Here is a 5-line summary of the conversation:

1. The task was to refactor a Vuex store by separating chat logic from project logic into dedicated store modules.
2. All chat-related state (`chats`, `chatsById`) and getters (`allChats`, `allTags`, `allPRs`) were moved from `project.js` to `chats.js`.
3. All chat actions (`loadChats`, `createNewChat`, `deleteChat`, `setActiveChat`, `onChatEvent`, etc.) were consolidated into `chats.js` and updated to use `$storex.chats.*` references.
4. The `project.js` store was cleaned up to delegate all chat concerns to `$storex.chats`, while retaining project, kanban, profile, branch, and workspace logic.
5. The result is a cleaner separation of concerns where `chats.js` fully owns chat state and operations, and `project.js` accesses chats only via `$storex.chats`.

messages.content: Add a chatsById dict to hold all chats loaded by id (chat id is a uuid so no collisions can happen) everytime a chat is loaded update it in the chat map
Move all load and store logic to chat store if project store needs to access chats will do through $storex.chats
